sections.content: A simple Hungarian sentence about habits can follow this order: the time first, then how often, then the verb, then the rest. It is a safe default, not the only possible order.

sections.title: Nem and the subject
sections.content: *Nem* stands right before the verb, as before: *Reggel nem tanulok.* You usually leave out the subject word, because the verb ending shows the person.

items.english: In the morning I always read.
In the evening we rarely cook.
At noon I do not have lunch.

sections.content: English likes the verb early: “I always read in the morning.” Hungarian often starts with the time and keeps the verb for later: *Reggel mindig olvasok.*
